name: Saki_zx.ZERO_CATEGORY.fredojunktion
original_name: 咲_zx.零種フレードジャンクション
source:
Singer: [url=/s430]Akiko Shikata[/url]

A mysterious Reyvateil from the Archia Think Tank.
She was created to fulfill a grand purpose that will have a major impact on the world itself.
But before she could fulfill that purpose, she and Kiraha, an Archian agent who opposed the plan, fled from the Think Tank together.
After a few years, she meets [url=/c39367]Aoto[/url] in Blue Canyon Hamlet.
Under extreme pressure, she resorts to a special power called "Miracle".

[From [url=http://nisamerica.com/games/atq/]official site[/url]]
